meta.title: SUtech Transport
meta.description: Book your seat on the university bus, track it live and show your digital card.

common.notFoundBody: Check the link or go back home.
common.forbiddenTitle: This page isn't available to you
common.forbiddenBody: Your role doesn't include this page. Ask a super admin if you need it.

errors.FORBIDDEN: This account isn't allowed to do that.
errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Some details are missing or invalid. Check them and try again.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: No connection. Check your internet and try again.
errors.BAD_RESPONSE: The server sent an unexpected reply. Tell the transport office if it keeps happening.
errors.INVALID_OTP: Wrong code. Check it and try again.
errors.OTP_LOCKED: The code is locked after 3 wrong tries. Ask for a new one.
errors.UNKNOWN_IDENTIFIER: This number isn't registered. Check it, or contact student affairs.
errors.ACCOUNT_DISABLED: This account is turned off. Contact the transport office.
errors.SEAT_UNAVAILABLE: This line is full. Pick another line.
errors.ALREADY_SUBSCRIBED: You already have a subscription or booking.
errors.SUBSCRIPTION_REQUIRED: Only active subscribers can do this.
errors.RESERVATION_EXPIRED: Your reservation expired or isn't waiting for payment. Book again.
errors.DUPLICATE_REFERENCE: This transaction reference was already used.
errors.OPEN_REQUEST_EXISTS: You already have an open request. Wait for it to finish.
errors.INVALID_STATE: Things changed. Refresh and try again.
errors.CARD_INVALID: This card isn't valid (cancelled or not genuine).
errors.CARD_EXPIRED: The code expired. Ask the student to reopen their card.
errors.WRONG_LINE: This student isn't on this line.
errors.SOS_ALREADY_OPEN: There's already an open SOS; the office is on it.
errors.LAST_SUPER_ADMIN: At least one super admin must stay active.
errors.UNKNOWN: Something unexpected happened. Try again in a moment.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.heading: Welcome
auth.subheading: Sign in to book and track your bus.
auth.identifierHint: Students use their 9-digit university ID. Parents and staff use their account ID.
auth.wrongCode: Wrong code. Enter the 4 digits you received.

demo.title: Demo accounts
demo.body: Pick an account to fill its ID, then ask for the code.

home.bookingOpenBody: Booking is open until {date}. Pick your line and reserve a seat.
home.bookingClosedBody: We'll announce here as soon as booking opens.
home.payWithin: Pay before the hold runs out
home.underReviewBody: Finance is reviewing it. You'll be notified when the subscription is active.

day.notGoingBody: Let the driver know so they don't wait. Your parent is notified, and it isn't counted as an absence.
day.skippedBody: You reported you're not going today. Changed your mind? Undo it before the bus passes.
day.confirmBody: The driver, supervisor, transport office and your parent will be told.

lines.title: Lines
lines.subtitle: Pick the line nearest you, then your stop.
lines.bookingClosed: Booking is closed. You can browse lines but not book.
lines.seatsLeft: {count, plural, one {# seat left} other {# seats left}}
lines.alreadyHolding: You already hold a seat. To switch lines, file a line change request.
lines.lineFull: This line is full. Pick another line.
lines.holdNote: The seat is held for 24 hours. If you don't pay in time, the hold is released. The price is fixed from now.

payment.title: Payment
payment.pickLineFirst: Pick a line and reserve first
payment.fawryBody: Get a Fawry reference to pay at any Fawry outlet or your banking app. The subscription activates by itself once paid.
payment.fawryAfter: After you pay you'll get a notification and your card will be ready.
payment.referenceHint: The number printed on the receipt (letters and digits).
payment.referenceInvalid: The reference must be 6–40 English letters or digits.
payment.receiptHint: JPG, PNG or WEBP, up to 5 MB.
payment.receiptTooBig: The image is larger than 5 MB.
payment.cancelBody: The seat goes back to other students. If you book again, you'll pay the price at that time.

card.title: Digital card
card.subtitle: Show it to the supervisor when you board.
card.inactiveTitle: The card is for active subscribers
card.inactiveBody: Finish booking and payment and your card appears here.
card.noScreenshot: The code changes, so a screenshot won't work.

requests.title: Requests
requests.body: Refund, line change, project model, guardian

complaints.title: Complaints
complaints.body: File a complaint and follow the reply

chat.title: Assistant
chat.body: Ask about transport, booking and payment

payment.title: Payment
payment.body: Pay with Fawry or upload a receipt

tracking.title: Track the bus
tracking.etaToStop: Bus reaches your stop in {minutes, plural, =0 {under a minute} one {# min} other {# min}}
tracking.etaToHome: You reach your stop in {minutes, plural, =0 {under a minute} one {# min} other {# min}}
tracking.endedBody: This trip is over. See you on the next one.
tracking.delayed: The bus is running about {minutes} min late
tracking.mapLabel: Map of {line} and the bus position
tracking.inactiveBody: Once your subscription is active you can track the bus live.

announcements.title: Announcements
announcements.subtitle: Everything the office sent to your line and to everyone.

settings.title: Settings
settings.name: Name
settings.guardianBody: Guardian details can't be edited here. File a request and the transport office reviews it with student affairs.

preferences.title: Notifications
preferences.alwaysOn: Safety alerts (SOS, early check-out, absence) are always sent.

demo.title: Demo data
demo.body: This is a demo. Its data is saved on this device only. You can put it back to how it started.
demo.confirmBody: Everything done in the demo on this device will be cleared, and you will sign in again.

requests.title: Requests
requests.subtitle: One open request at a time.
requests.oneOpen: You have an open request. You can file another once it's closed.
requests.emptyBody: Ask for a refund, a line change, a project model trip, or a guardian change.

form.onlyGuardian: Other requests are for active subscribers only.
form.refundNote: We're in week {week}, with a {percent}% deduction. Finance confirms the final amount.
form.fieldHint: The new details are verified with student affairs first.
form.invalid: Fill in the details and a reason (at least 3 characters).

complaints.title: Complaints
complaints.subtitle: The transport office answers every complaint.
complaints.textHint: Say when and where it happened, at least 10 characters.
complaints.tooShort: Too short. Write at least 10 characters.

chat.title: Assistant
chat.subtitle: Answers about transport, booking and payment.
chat.hello: Hi! Ask me anything about the buses.
chat.disclaimer: The assistant can make mistakes. Official decisions come from the transport office.

crew.reportSubtitle: Report a delay or a violation.

trip.supervisorNote: The driver starts and ends the trip. You scan the students' cards.
trip.endBodyOutbound: {count, plural, =0 {Every student is accounted for.} one {# unscanned student will be marked absent and their parent notified.} other {# unscanned students will be marked absent and their parents notified.}} Students on board are marked as arrived.
trip.endBodyReturn: Students on board are marked as home.
trip.riders: {count, plural, one {# rider} other {# riders}} on this line

riders.empty: No subscribed students on this line.

scan.title: Scan card
scan.checkoutWarning: The parent is notified immediately; the university isn't responsible after the student leaves.
scan.cameraDenied: Camera access is blocked. Allow it in the browser settings, or type the student ID below.
scan.cameraUnsupported: This browser can't read QR codes with the camera. Type the student ID below.
scan.manualHint: 9 digits, if the camera can't read the code.

delay.title: Report a delay
delay.onlyRunning: Delays can only be reported during a trip.

violation.title: Report a violation
violation.invalidPhoto: Must be an image under 5 MB.

sos.title: Emergency report
sos.body: The transport office gets this at once with the bus position. In immediate danger call the ambulance (123) first.
sos.waitingOffice: Waiting for the transport office to confirm. Stay with the students.
sos.officeOnIt: The office is handling it. Updates appear here.

parent.title: My children
parent.noChildren: No children linked to this account.
parent.noChildrenBody: Ask the transport office to link your account to the student ID.
parent.notSubscribed: Not subscribed to transport this term.

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.subtitle: Refund and line change requests start with your approval.
approvals.nothingWaiting: Nothing is waiting for your approval.
approvals.approved: Approved and sent to the transport office

overview.title: Overview
overview.subtitle: Today's numbers and what's happening live.

sos.title: SOS reports
sos.subtitle: Acknowledge new reports at once, then close them with what happened.
sos.openMap: Open the bus location on the map
sos.acknowledged: Acknowledged; the crew can see it
sos.noteHint: For the log, or the closing summary (at least 3 characters).
sos.noFreeBus: No free bus with a driver right now.

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.subtitle: Who boarded, arrived or was absent, by day.

announcements.title: Announcements & delays
announcements.subtitle: Official news and line alerts. Deleting removes it for everyone.
announcements.cleared: Riders told the bus is back on schedule
announcements.deleteBody: It disappears for every student and parent, including their notifications. If it's a delay, the delay is cleared too.

form.title: Title
form.invalid: Complete the form: title at least 3 and text at least 5 characters.

lines.title: Lines & stops
lines.subtitle: A new price applies to new bookings only.
lines.name: Line name
lines.gateNote: The university gate is added as the last stop.
lines.invalid: Complete the form: name, price from EGP 1, and a name and time for each stop.
lines.noFreeBus: No free bus. Add one on the buses page first.

buses.title: Buses & drivers
buses.subtitle: Plate or driver changes are announced to the line's riders.
buses.lineNotice: This bus serves {line}; riders are told about changes.
buses.invalid: Check the details: plate and type at least 3 characters, 8 to 80 seats.

students.title: Students
students.subtitle: Search, move a student to another line, or cancel a subscription.
students.name: Name
students.permanentNote: The student is placed at the first active stop of the new line.
students.transferred: Student moved; student and parent notified
students.cancelWarning: {name}'s subscription is cancelled and the card stops working. Refunds go through a refund request.

departures.title: Extra trips
departures.subtitle: Extra return trips today, usually when a lecture ends early or late.
departures.invalid: Fill in the time, bus and a reason (at least 3 characters).

term.title: Term & booking
term.subtitle: Open or close booking and set the next term.
term.closeBody: No new bookings. Existing ones are not affected.
term.name: Term name
term.announce: Publish a pinned announcement with the dates to everyone
term.invalid: Check the dates: opening from today, closing after opening, start after closing.

payments.title: Payments
payments.subtitle: Review InstaPay and bank receipts. Fawry confirms itself.
payments.rejectBody: The student sees the reason and can upload another before the hold ends.

requests.title: Requests
requests.subtitle: Refunds, line changes, project models and guardian changes.
requests.reasonHint: The student and parent will see it.

violations.title: Violations
violations.subtitle: Reports from the bus crews. Student affairs refers or dismisses them.

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Export rosters, payments, attendance and occupancy.
reports.demoCsv: In the demo files come out as CSV. The real server exports Excel and PDF.

roster.title: Rider roster
roster.body: Subscribed students on each line and their stops.

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.body: Each student's status on a given day.

occupancy.title: Occupancy
occupancy.body: Booked and free seats per line.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Who did what and when. This log can't be edited.

clinic.title: Clinic
clinic.subtitle: Medical permits: priority seat, medical leave or an escort.
clinic.invalid: Enter a 9-digit student ID and an end date after the start.

secretaryGeneral.title: Secretary general's office
secretaryGeneral.subtitle: Read-only: the numbers, complaints and their replies.

events.title: Events
events.subtitle: Free university buses first; the rest is requested from the bus company.
events.name: Event name
events.invalid: Enter a name (3+ characters), a date from today, and 1–5000 students.

busCompany.title: Bus requests
busCompany.subtitle: Requests from the university for extra event buses.
busCompany.busesRequested: {count, plural, one {# bus requested} other {# buses requested}}

users.title: Users & roles
users.subtitle: Staff accounts and roles. At least one super admin must stay active.
users.name: Name
users.invalid: Name must be at least 3 characters.
